name: Baserow
desc: Open-source online database tool, alternative to Airtable

actions.name: baserow_create_row
actions.description: Creates a new row in a table.

actions.name: baserow_get_row
actions.description: Gets a single row by its ID from a table.

actions.name: baserow_list_rows
actions.description: Lists rows from a table with optional search, sorting, and filtering.

actions.name: baserow_find_row
actions.description: Finds a row by matching a field value. Returns the first match.

actions.name: baserow_update_row
actions.description: Updates fields in an existing row. Empty values are skipped. To clear a field, use Clean Row.

actions.name: baserow_upsert_row
actions.description: Creates a new row or updates an existing one by matching a field value.

actions.name: baserow_clean_row
actions.description: Sets all fields in a row to empty/null. To update only specific fields, use Update Row instead.

actions.name: baserow_batch_create_rows
actions.description: Creates multiple rows in a single request. Accepts up to 200 rows.

actions.name: baserow_batch_update_rows
actions.description: Updates multiple rows in a single request. Each row must include an "id" field. Accepts up to 200 rows.

actions.name: baserow_batch_delete_rows
actions.description: Deletes multiple rows in a single request. Accepts up to 200 row IDs.

actions.name: baserow_aggregate_field
actions.description: Calculates an aggregation (sum, average, min, max, count, etc.) over all values of a field in a grid view.

actions.name: baserow_upload_file
actions.description: Uploads a file to Baserow from a URL. Returns the uploaded file object that can be used in file fields.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: baserow_row_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new row is created in a Baserow table.

triggers.name: baserow_row_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing row is updated in a Baserow table.

triggers.name: baserow_row_deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a row is deleted from a Baserow table.

triggers.name: baserow_row_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a row is created, updated, or deleted in a Baserow table. To react to only one event type, use the dedicated New Row, Updated Row, or Deleted Row triggers.

triggers.name: baserow_rows_created
triggers.description: Triggers when new rows are created in a Baserow table. Returns all rows from the event as a single batch.

triggers.name: baserow_rows_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when existing rows are updated in a Baserow table. Returns all rows from the event as a single batch.

triggers.name: baserow_rows_deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when rows are deleted from a Baserow table. Returns all deleted row IDs from the event as a single batch.
